features.name: ParcelSeal.registerPlot: H3 cell registry that reverts on overlap
features.summary: Registers a plot for a season as an array of uint64 H3 cell ids. It marks (season,cell) keys as taken, reverts CellAlreadyTaken on any overlap, stores cellsHash and cellCount, and assigns an incrementing plotId. The contract does not itself compute H3 and trusts the caller-supplied cell ids.
features.registry_match: H3 cell land registry that reverts on any overlapping plot

features.name: One claim per (plot, season)
features.summary: submitClaim reverts with ClaimAlreadyRecorded if a claim of any verdict is already recorded for that plot and season. It also checks PlotNotFound and SeasonMismatch.
features.registry_match: One claim per plot and season

features.name: Oracle-signed verdict verification on-chain (EIP-191, nonce, deadline, chain and contract binding)
features.summary: verdictDigest binds contract, chainid, plot, season, verdict, evidenceHash, nonce and deadline. submitClaim recovers the signer, requires it to equal the oracle, and rejects replayed nonces and expired signatures. Only NoBurn writes a payout-eligible Attestation. Burned and Uncertain are stored as rejectedVerdicts.
features.registry_match: Oracle-signed NoBurn / Burned / Uncertain verdicts from FIRMS and Sentinel-2

features.name: Owner-only oracle key rotation
features.summary: Ownable contract with setOracle(newOracle) and an OracleUpdated event.

features.name: Two-signal verdict rule (FIRMS + Sentinel-2 dNBR)
features.summary: A deterministic rule: NoBurn if both signals are present and clean, Burned if both are positive, Uncertain if any signal is missing or the two disagree. FIRMS counts rows inside the plot with confidence n or h. A scar is positive at mean dNBR >= 0.10 or >= 25% of pixels with dNBR >= 0.15.
features.registry_match: Oracle-signed NoBurn / Burned / Uncertain verdicts from FIRMS and Sentinel-2

features.name: Canonical evidence bundle keccak-256 hash (tamper-evidence)
features.summary: Hashes sorted-key compact JSON, so mutating any bundle field changes the evidenceHash that the oracle signature covers. A SHA-256 cross-check is also provided.

features.name: Oracle signing module (struct hash, digest, sign, recover)
features.summary: Reproduces the contract's verdictDigest in Python using eth_account and signs the raw struct hash with EIP-191 personal-sign. The key comes from the ORACLE_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable or .env and is never returned.

features.name: FastAPI oracle service (/health, /fixtures, /evaluate, /sign, /verify)
features.summary: /sign returns the exact submitClaim arguments plus the digest. /verify recomputes the evidence hash and recovers the signer to detect tampering. /health reports whether signing is available without exposing key material.
features.registry_match: Oracle-signed NoBurn / Burned / Uncertain verdicts from FIRMS and Sentinel-2

features.name: sign_claim.py CLI
features.summary: Evaluates and signs a named fixture bundle for a given plot, season and nonce, and prints the JSON. It is used by the Hardhat round-trip test.

features.name: Baked-in evidence fixtures (4 demo plots) and generator
features.summary: Plot 1 is clean, plot 2 is burned (partly mirrored per its own provenance label), plot 3 is cloudy and plot 4 is a duplicate outline. build_fixtures.py uses the h3 library to compute cells and writes the fixture JSON. There is no live FIRMS or Planetary Computer fetch in the repo, and the Sentinel-2 values are hardcoded in the generator.
features.registry_match: Four demo plots with fixture evidence; Sentinel-2 items are real Planetary Computer measurements

features.name: Leaflet map UI with plot polygons, FIRMS markers and plot cards
features.summary: A static page with satellite and OSM base layers. The four plots are coloured by verdict, FIRMS detections are markers, there are shortcut cards, and the evidence panel shows per-plot metrics, FIRMS rows, provenance and previous/next navigation.
features.registry_match: Demo map and Polygon Amoy testnet contract

features.name: Duplicate-registration (CellAlreadyTaken) explanation panel
features.summary: Plot 4's panel shows the overlap count and the recorded revert error from the eth_call replay. The revert result is stored data in data.js, not a live call from the page.
features.registry_match: H3 cell land registry that reverts on any overlapping plot

features.name: Plot 1 on-chain record panel with explorer links
features.summary: Shows the contract, registration and claim tx links, blocks, evidence hash, cells hash and nonce from static data.js. The page makes no live chain read.
features.registry_match: Demo map and Polygon Amoy testnet contract

features.name: Browser tamper-evidence demo
features.summary: Recomputes a SHA-256 over the canonicalised plot-1 bundle and shows MATCH or MISMATCH after the user sets dNBR to 0.24. It uses SHA-256, not the keccak-256 the oracle and chain use, and says so.

features.name: Impact-accounting explainer (CH4+N2O as CO2e, no biogenic CO2, PM2.5)
features.summary: Three static explanatory cards in index.html. No code was found that computes CO2e or PM2.5 figures, so this is narrative only.

features.name: Hardhat deploy script and Amoy network config
features.summary: Deploys ParcelSeal with an oracle address to Polygon Amoy (chainId 80002), checks the balance, and prints the explorer and verify commands. The hardhat config uses environment keys and a custom Polygonscan chain.
features.registry_match: Demo map and Polygon Amoy testnet contract

features.name: Amoy deployment and replay record (README-documented)
features.summary: The README documents the contract address, deploy and replay transactions, the plot 1 attestation and a Sourcify exact match. These are only documented in prose, and there is no deployments/*.json file. The web footer says PolygonScan verification is pending, which disagrees with the README.
features.registry_match: Demo map and Polygon Amoy testnet contract

features.name: Hardhat contract tests and Python-oracle round-trip test
features.summary: PlotLock.test.js has 13 cases covering registration, overlap, seasons, claim idempotency, burned/uncertain verdicts, wrong signer, nonce replay, expiry and unknown plot. OracleSignature.test.js has Python-signed acceptance plus tamper rejection.

features.name: Python oracle pytest suite
features.summary: Covers fixture verdicts, missing/conflicting signals, confidence filtering, outside-plot detections, H3 overlap of the duplicate fixture, hash stability and mutation, a digest known-answer test, the signature round trip and the API sign/verify/tamper flow.

features.name: README and oracle README with provenance, honesty notes and limitations
features.summary: Documents the verdict rule, signing convention, fixture provenance (real vs mirrored), the endpoint table and limitations such as no-detection not proving no-burn, and ECDSA not being post-quantum safe.
